correctness.rationale: An exact all-real-parameter mode count follows from the positive and negative half-line slope functions H_R and H_L. Their derivative numerators are z^3-8z+4 and z^3-8z-4, each with exactly one relevant minimizer; equality produces only a stationary nonextremum. Their strict order follows from H_R(z)-H_L(z)=(4-2z^2)/(6 z^(2/3)(z^2-1)) at z=z_L>3. The cusp stays a strict mode for every finite tilt and the limiting normalized density has two modes. The embedded checker independently verifies normalization, algebra, rational isolation intervals and numerical values.
